XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: ignition lock

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminated, passenger compartment air conditioning fan not working and sporadic key lock in the ignition switch during start-up

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U3010 (Ignition switch position - error)

  • Cause: faulty ignition switch

• Intervention: Check that the ignition lock shown in the figure is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, it was not necessary to replace the key cylinder. The faulty component did not show any visual abnormalities and, after replacement, no reprogramming was necessary using a self-diagnostic tester.
